account: A Changan brochure for the Qiyuan E07 SUV, uploaded to the company's GitHub repository on 28 May 2025, markets scenarios that drivers program by voice through an AI large model. In its project account for the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, Changan reports that its vehicle agent demonstration reduces scenario configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. The account states that configuring a scenario typically takes several minutes and needs technical knowledge. It cites the brochure. It lists only a Douyin video as its testbed and reports no timing study. Development continues. No source measures safety or environmental benefits.
